curation_note.it: Il rapporto associa sia l'idrometro sia il danneggiamento parziale della pila al Ponte Samone. Il colmo validato di 1,82 m fu registrato alle 22:30 locali del 5 dicembre; è una quota relativa allo zero idrometrico locale, non un tirante sulla pila né una portata.
curation_note.en: The report associates both the gauge and partial pier damage with Ponte Samone. The validated 1.82 m peak was recorded at 22:30 local time on 5 December; it is relative to the local gauge datum, not flow depth at the pier or discharge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The value describes the named official station and is not assigned to the collapsed bridge section.
Sensor readings and post-event topographic surveys retain their distinct evidence types.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
No bridge return period or causal probability is inferred from the basin reference.
